CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 11 / 14

Long-run equilibrium and changes

Entry and supply adjustment進入與供給調整

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Trace how positive profit induces entry and shifts market supply right, while losses induce exit and shift supply left, under free entry and exit.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求及相關成本不變下，正利潤吸引進入使市場供給右移、價跌；虧損引致退出使供給左移、價升，直到進出誘因消失。

Positive profit induces entry, shifting market supply right and lowering price; losses induce exit, shifting supply left and raising price, holding demand and relevant costs fixed. Adjustment continues until entry or exit incentives disappear.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A profitable wheat industry attracts farmers. Greater market supply reduces price and each firm's economic profit. 更多企業分攤市場需求。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Firms incur persistent losses and exit. Market supply moves? 虧損退出後市場供給？
